career_ladder.note: Cadre progression for ministerial and field staff in the Andaman & Nicobar Administration is governed by the Andaman & Nicobar Administration Subordinate Ministerial Service Rules and department-specific recruitment rules. For the clerical stream, entry is at Lower Grade Clerk / Lower Division Clerk (Pay Level 2), advancing through regular promotion or departmental examinations to Higher Grade Clerk / Upper Division Clerk (Pay Level 4), Assistant Section Officer / Head Clerk (Pay Level 6), and Section Officer / Office Superintendent (Pay Level 7 / Level 8), with senior promotional avenues into the Assistant Secretary cadre (Pay Level 10). For the Revenue cadre, Patwaris (Pay Level 3) advance to Revenue Inspector / Kanungo (Pay Level 5) and Tehsildar / Naib Tehsildar (Pay Level 6/7).

exam_scheme.note: The examination scheme for the Combined Higher Secondary Level Recruitment Examination (CHSLRE) is prescribed in Advertisement No. 02/HSL/2026 (File No. 4-12/2026-R&E Cell/214 dated 04/06/2026). The selection comprises two stages: Stage 1 is an Online Tablet Based Test (TBT) / Computer Based Test of 200 multiple-choice questions for 200 marks lasting 120 minutes (2 hours). Questions are bilingual (English and Hindi) except for General English. There is negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer. Candidates qualifying the TBT in order of merit appear for Stage 2, which consists of post-specific Trade / Skill / Physical tests (e.g. 35 w.p.m. English / 30 w.p.m. Hindi computer typing test for Lower Grade Clerks, 80 w.p.m. shorthand and 40/45 w.p.m. typing for Stenographers, physical endurance for Foresters), which are strictly qualifying in nature.

financial_package.note: Andaman & Nicobar Islands is a Union Territory directly administered by the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs); administration staff are Central Civil Services employees governed under the Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix. The foundational clerical entry post of Lower Grade Clerk / Lower Division Clerk is positioned at Pay Level 2 (entry basic pay ₹19,900; scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200). Patwari and Village Level Worker posts are positioned at Pay Level 3 (entry basic pay ₹21,700; scale ₹21,700 - ₹69,100), and Stenographers / UDCs are positioned at Pay Level 4 (entry basic pay ₹25,500; scale ₹25,500 - ₹81,100). In addition to 58% Central DA and standard HRA/Transport Allowance, personnel serving in the islands are entitled to Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) under Ministry of Finance orders ranging from 10% (Port Blair / South Andaman) up to 20% (difficult / remote Nicobar group of islands).
financial_package.pay_source_label: A&N Administration Secretariat — Advt. No. 02/HSL/2026, Post Code 227/26 (Pay Scale: Pay Matrix Level 2, ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 for Lower Grade Clerk)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 2 (Lower Grade Clerk) at Entry Basic Pay of ₹19,900 with DA at 58% (₹11,542). Includes House Rent Allowance (9% / ₹1,791 for island towns, or government quarter allotment), Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + DA ₹783 = ₹2,133, or ₹900 + DA ₹522 = ₹1,422), and Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) at 10% (₹1,990) to 20% (₹3,980) of Basic Pay depending on island posting zone. Deductions include mandatory NPS employee contribution (10% of Basic + DA = ₹3,144) and CGEGIS/insurance, yielding estimated in-hand pay of ₹32,000 to ₹37,000. (For Level 3 Patwari at basic ₹21,700, estimated in-hand is ₹34,500 - ₹40,000; for Level 4 Stenographer at basic ₹25,500, estimated in-hand is ₹39,000 - ₹46,000).
official_perks: Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) of 10% to 20% of Basic Pay depending on island posting zone (Port Blair vs remote Nicobar Islands)
Government departmental residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) including sea/air passage between mainland India (Kolkata/Chennai) and Port Blair per Central Government Island LTC rules
Central Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (CGEGIS) and Central Civil Services Medical Attendance (CS(MA)) rules
Defined contribution pension under the National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government employer contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: Vacancy numbers and selection statistics are sourced directly from Andaman & Nicobar Administration recruitment notices and published press notes. In the 2026 Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSLRE) recruitment cycle (Advt. No. 02/HSL/2026), 716 total vacancies were notified across Group B(NG) and Group C posts (including 426 Lower Grade Clerks in Secretariat, 33 Stenographers, 36 Foresters, and 8 Patwaris). In the 2023 cycle (Notification No. 4-12/2023/R&E/462 conducted with SSC assistance), 488 vacancies were notified, 478 candidates were recommended for selection, and 472 appointment offers were issued at the 3rd Rozgar Mela at Netaji Stadium, Port Blair, followed by an additional select list for 90 resultant vacancies in October 2024. In the 2022 recruitment cycle (F.No. 1-3/2022-R&E Cell), 565 vacancies were notified (including 453 LGCs in Secretariat, 37 Stenographers, 8 Patwaris, and 19 Tally Clerks).
